_comment: Pinned known-good refs for cross-repo integration, matching Eclipse S-CORE's reference-integration-repo concept (see the folder-structure feasibility note in the claude.ai project attached to this repo's session history). docs.yml and ci-needs.yml check out qorix-gnc and qorix-vnv at these refs by default (a workflow_dispatch input can still override for a one-off test build). .github/workflows/integration-check.yml is the only thing that should ever update this file automatically -- it trial-builds against each dependency's latest commit on its default branch and, only if that build passes with warnings-as-errors, opens a PR bumping the ref here. A manual edit + PR is also fine if you want to pin ahead of what integration-check.yml has tried.

qorix-gnc.updated_by: manual seed -- not yet validated by integration-check.yml

qorix-vnv.updated_by: manual seed -- not yet validated by integration-check.yml
